hero-subtitle: Your brew.  Your vintage.  Right Here In Squamish.
intro-title: Squamish's Ferment-on-Premises and Homebrew Supply Shop
intro-text: Squamish's ferment-on-premises destination for handcrafted wine. Choose from a wide selection of premium wine kits, and we'll guide you through every step, from grape to glass. You start the batch, we handle the heavy lifting, and you walk away with bottles you're proud to pour.
beer-text: We've expanded into craft beer. Brew your own pilsners, IPAs, stouts, and more, right here in our shop. Same hands-on experience, same expert guidance, a whole new world of flavour.
cider-text: Our newest addition—craft cider made with 100% Okanagan juice. Same hands-on experience, same expert guidance, a bright new option on the menu.
uferment-text: U-Ferment is a service where you craft professional-grade wine, beer, or cider at a licensed facility. We provide the ingredients and equipment while handling the storage and technical monitoring of the fermentation process for you. Each batch produces approximately 23 litres, that’s ~29 bottles (750 mL). And because you make it yourself on our premises, your batch is not subject to liquor taxes—one of the reasons U-Ferment is so affordable.
howitworks-text: Making your own wine in Squamish takes four steps. Wine kits start at $190 and yield 28–30 bottles; cider kits start at $125.
why-text: Making your own wine in Squamish is a chance to walk away with bottles you made yourself. Each batch yields 28–30 bottles, ready for custom labels with your photo, a wedding date, or whatever fits the occasion. Wine kits start at $190 and cider kits from $125. Because U-Vin Squamish batches are made on-premises for personal use, they aren't subject to liquor taxes. Customers bottle for weddings, engagement parties, retirement gifts, and housewarmings—anytime a store-bought bottle doesn't quite fit the moment.
supplies-text: Steins & Vines isn't just a ferment-on-premise shop. We stock homebrew supplies in Squamish for home brewers across the Sea-to-Sky: brewing ingredients like yeast, hops, grains, and malt extract; winemaking additives and fining agents; sanitizers, cleaners, hydrometers, airlocks, and fermentation gear. Mid-batch and running low on priming sugar? Need a replacement airlock? Skip the drive to Vancouver—we've probably got it. Starter kits too, for anyone who wants to make their own beer in Squamish or take on wine making at home.
seatosky-text: Whether you're local to Squamish, driving down from Whistler or Pemberton, or up from the North Shore, it's worth the trip. Steins & Vines is a dedicated U-Brew Squamish and homebrew supply shop serving the Sea-to-Sky. Reserve a kit online, book a batch that fits your schedule, and plan to leave with ~29 bottles of wine you made yourself—or a cart of brewing ingredients to keep your home setup running. Our customers come from all corners of the corridor, including Whistler regulars who bottle the same day they drive back.
